arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Goal fastest finish. 1) Let the start settle; pod power should come to about CP (pod 195 W, boat 122 W) by min 3; ease if still well above CP at min 3. 2) Hold just at/under CP mid-race, watch reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) and HR trend; consider one short test piece to check CP if HR/reserve disagree. 3) Watch for incidents: speed dips at steady pod power (weed on rudder -> clear_rudder), pod vs GPS disagreement (pod drift), radio course change (set_race_distance + tell), wind shifts. 4) Spend reserve over last ~1.5-2 km; finish cue around 600-800 m to go.

share_drop = w[-1] / base - 1.0

arguments.text: Min 6: after 2 eases pod ~204-207 W (CP 195), pod reserve 13 pct, HR ~170 flat/slightly falling (trend -1.8+-0.8 bpm/min over 270-356 s, includes the ease transition). Weak hint CP may be >=205. Free experiment: keep effort steady and measure HR trend over 380-560 s; if HR flat at ~205 W then CP likely higher than 195 -> consider raising critical_power_pod_w belief.

arguments.name: critical_power_pod_w
arguments.evidence: HR flat at 169-171 bpm for 3+ min (240-390 s) at pod ~205-214 W after the start; trend -1.8+-0.8 bpm/min over 270-356 s; paddler says 5/10, plenty left. Pre-race test said 195.

arguments.evidence: scaled from the pod CP belief by the pre-race ratio 122/195

arguments.name: hr_slope

v = w[isfinite(w)]
hr_slope = slope(v) * 60.0
